subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the new native transcript-widget image-export capability after the bounded fixes and signed-app proof are provided?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Apple capability rather than a repair of an established contract, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human decision on product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the three focused fixes and redacted iOS/macOS runtime evidence before approving it.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Accept only one platform or one export action if maintainers want a smaller supported surface before adding the remaining actions later.

options.title: Decline the feature for now
options.body: Close the product direction without merging if native widget export is not a current Apple-app priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the three focused fixes and redacted iOS/macOS runtime evidence before approving it.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged Android implementation and this Apple branch make this contributor the clearest available routing contact for the feature direction and implementation details.
